contexts.text: A kind of hissing was heard in Gehenna; but the hiss or whisper of Gehenna was grosser... SE 3469.
A mere hiss would terrify them... SE 3749.
Jehovah shall hiss for the fly... ().
Their speech falls between the teeth with some hiss.
The sound of their speech was sibilant.
Faith is (then) only like the shrill sound of a whistle.
Who... would not hiss at these things...
Do they not rather hiss at these things...
With a slight sound of a hiss... Such was the quick sound of that hiss or like that of serpents.
A kind of continuous hiss (from an adulteress).
There is heard as it were a silent hiss after their speech; and this from the interior deceit.
He hath hissed to him from the extremity of the earth ().
The hissings of the flocks = their perceptions and thoughts.
Everyone that passeth over it shall hiss... () = contempt for and rejection of them by those who are in the truths and goods of doctrine.
The devastation of all truth and good... is signified by, Let Babel be... for a hiss... ().
